\chapter{Evidence registers}
\label{app:mono-registers}

This appendix renders the compact evidence registers of the monograph (\file{research_monograph/evidence/}). Facts carry stable identifiers cited in the text as \fact{NNN}; claims of the ledger as \claim{C0NN}; monograph synthesis claims as M0NN. The verification column states how each fact was checked: \emph{raw-verified} (the value was found at the cited line of the raw Quantum ESPRESSO output), \emph{raw-derived-verified} (recomputed from raw geometry), \emph{independent-recompute} (recomputed by a monograph script from the data), \emph{derived-from-raw-verified} (a difference of raw-verified values), \emph{json-only} or \emph{log-and-json} (taken from the re-derivation outputs or the dated log, not re-checked here), and \emph{ledger-only}. A summary is never stronger evidence than its raw source.
